subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Picking up my earlier email about validated referrals for {Brand}. As Google Shopping keeps folding comparison and checkout into one surface, the referral you bill on gets harder to credit cleanly. On a CPS economy billing a 5% to 30% take with affiliate conversion at a 1% to 3% baseline (partnero 2025), incrementality and a clean postback decide your margin. We read paid referrals against a holdout, so you pay only for the outbound clicks that survive it and convert. Worth comparing against your merchant mix?
angle: fresh angle: comparison-and-checkout surfaces collapsing + CPS take and affiliate-conversion band (sourced)
register_notes: Stage 2 EN comparison_aggregator: acknowledges follow-up and references the prior email in the first sentence; fresh angle = comparison and checkout surfaces collapsing on Google Shopping, making clean referral crediting harder, paired with the verified benchmark band (CPS take 5-30% and affiliate conversion 1-3% baseline, partnero 2025); MobUpps holdout/incrementality referenced with no figure; market numbers REAL and sourced with URL in enrichment_sources (kept only the partnero source verified in the parent); exactly 1 question mark; no MobUpps figure this stage; only Google Shopping named, from the parent brand set; no brand outside the candidate set; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' (positive specifications); native English.
